snapshots.label: States: vocabulary is not rendered row-state coverage
snapshots.reason: The story passes eleven state names to a favicon without an image; only loading and error change that component branch. Hover, focus, selection, attention and drag labels do not paint those row states or drive input. Production-state applicability and framing remain open.

snapshots.label: Iconography: newer production glyphs are not enumerated
snapshots.reason: The explicit 25-sample list omits Search, Warning, Gear, Info, Document, settings/permission/media/split glyphs and curated Bbr glyph variants. Complete production-glyph coverage and nested bounds require an independently authored contract; no page counts are inferred.

snapshots.label: Core Controls: initial state and theme applicability
snapshots.reason: IDs 14-20 render default entities/recorder state. Capture changes gpui-component Light/Dark but does not explicitly propagate BBR contrast/density or drive pointer, editing, focus or disabled states. Canvas setting names are not proof of distinct control variants; nested shadows/focus extents remain unproven.

snapshots.label: Radio: initial selected option requires the checked asset
snapshots.reason: The first Radio is selected by default and calls checkbox_check_icon, which resolves icons/check.svg. The empty Gallery asset source cannot supply it; this affects initial Radio captures, not only a future Checkbox transition. Legitimate asset-source approval and fresh guest visual evidence are required.

snapshots.label: Tab Row: stale exclusions and unrepresented production branches
snapshots.reason: The matrix rejects bitmap favicons as unsupported although production FaviconSpec carries an image and renders it with decode fallback. Every fixture sets split to None; the focused label neither drives focus nor adds a production focus-ring branch. Current applicability and painted shadow/companion-glyph bounds need audit and guest evidence, not automatic promotion of stale rejection reasons or Split activation.

snapshots.label: Library: selected rows omit the selection toolbar and collection stages
snapshots.reason: The selection and multi fixtures set row flags but leave model.selected empty, so the production toolbar never renders. All eleven models leave move_sheet_open and collection_create_staged false and collection_action None. Recorder callbacks do not update these fixture models. Selection, move and collection create/rename/remove presentations remain missing coverage; selector names and dispatch tests cannot substitute for them.

snapshots.label: Library: a fixed scroll viewport is not complete nested framing
snapshots.reason: Large 1k supplies only rows 1-24 with scroll_offset zero inside a 520pt surface containing a nested scroll list. Outer pagination treats that entire surface as one child and never traverses its rows or scroll positions. Neither all 1000 records nor full visibility of the 24 supplied rows is proven; independently bounded viewport/framing requirements and guest review remain open.

snapshots.label: Address: current accessories, progress and site indicators are absent
snapshots.reason: All ten address fixtures set zoom None, progress Idle and the site default, omitting production zoom, loading/finish and live/blocked camera/microphone device branches. History and Welcome identity marks are absent. Hover is a fixture boolean, not recorder-driven state; the invisible anchor is not app overlay geometry. Current applicability and guest framing remain unproven.

snapshots.label: Command staging: caret endpoints do not cover selection or composition
snapshots.reason: All seven staging fixtures use EditState::end_of with selection and marked ranges absent and no line sink. Production edit_line paints selection, IME underline and an insertion caret with horizontal scrolling; focused labels and pointer-open recordings do not exercise editing, composition, input ownership or long-line framing. No sequence or page counts are inferred.

snapshots.label: Favorites: image and pop branches plus rail geometry remain uncovered
snapshots.reason: Every fixture has image None and every tile call has pop None, omitting production image/decode-fallback and favorite-pop branches. Tile widths derive from a 300pt rail but the story grid is not constrained to that rail width; flex-wrap content and nominal four-column labels need actual descendant framing. Static drag offers and recorder activations do not prove drag, reopen or selection transitions.

snapshots.label: Folders: count label hides the count and current render branches are absent
snapshots.reason: Every row sets reveal_count false and drop_target false; even the count tnum family renders its count at zero opacity and the story hover callback is a no-op. The rename draft is never selected and member images are None. Production count reveal, selected rename, drop outline, image fallback and group-hover close need explicit coverage; parent bounds do not establish nested lift/rename halo framing.

snapshots.label: Footer: omitted keyboard ring and fixture strip are not production-strip coverage
snapshots.reason: All eight footer calls pass downloads_focused false, so the production focus ring is absent. The fixture strip uses profile chips plus text, not the production space_chip/space_strip composition. Its horizontal scroll viewport has no authored scroll windows or descendant visibility evidence; overflow and active labels cannot prove production chip geometry, navigation or complete framing.

snapshots.label: Plus menu: shared item identities do not establish production renderer parity
snapshots.reason: The story uses production item/state data but builds its own card and selected border_l_2 rows. Current production plus_menu_surface uses rounded menu_cursor without that rail, all-side padding, elev2 shadow, focus and key/inside-press callbacks. Story pointer recording and pure selection-wrap tests are not production menu pixels or Enter/Escape transitions; renderer identity and framing remain open.

snapshots.label: Downloads: shared scroll state and static moments are not complete coverage
snapshots.reason: All families share one ScrollHandle that family_model repeatedly resets; the 22-row fixture supplies window 8..22 but later families reset the handle to zero. A six-row viewport and laid-out overscan bounds do not prove complete visible rows or scroll traversal. Every panel is open with alpha 1 and check None; focus/washes are static model values, not real focus, completion or fade transitions. Actual descendant/shadow framing and legitimate moment/input evidence remain open.

snapshots.label: Find: aliased wrapper targets do not measure production controls
snapshots.reason: with_find_id_targets wraps the first bar container with all seven production-id debug selectors; their wrapper bounds are not each actual control's bounds. Six static DTOs represent focus/query/count but recorder callbacks do not edit, step or close them. Input-driven focus and complete field/control/shadow framing remain unproven; fixture geometry does not establish native portal placement. No stale visual or disabled control is invented where the DTO has none.

snapshots.label: Error: offline fixtures omit the production illustration
snapshots.reason: build_error_fixture always sets illustration None, so even all three Offline families render Lifering. The app maps Offline to Some(None) and the production surface selects its drawn illustration. A separate foundational illustration sample does not prove this error composition. The 240pt frames and repeated-id presence checks do not establish full descendant visibility; recorder action/dismiss counts do not prove recovery.

snapshots.label: Recovery panes: the current unresponsive branch has no Gallery family
snapshots.reason: The pane matrix only builds Crash and Empty, both at rest in 260pt frames. Production also renders unresponsive_panel with Wait/Reload/Close and distinct focus handles; there is no Gallery call or registered family for it. Static rest illustrations remain legitimate but do not prove appearance motion, input-driven recovery or full descendant framing. This records missing coverage, not permission to implement a new product branch or synthesize native pixels.

snapshots.label: Context menu: fixed fixture height differs from production row geometry
snapshots.reason: Every four- or five-row family uses a fixed 148pt card, whereas app placement derives height from actual row count, label size and padding. Production rows use label text plus py(sp2), not density.row; semantic-test targeting still uses density.row. Static selected values and hover/press recordings do not mutate selection or dismiss the menu. Current row/last-control/shadow framing and geometry parity require measurement, without recreating WebKit-owned menus or guessing pages.

snapshots.label: Locked-session execution
snapshots.reason: Observed captures occurred on an unlocked console; no lock-state change was induced.
